result.summary: Found 1 major issue: low-contrast text in the promotional banner. Otherwise no visually broken layout was detected; partially visible carousel items on the right and the card cut off at the bottom are expected scrollable content.

issues.description: The promotional banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and its subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white / very light text on a pale mint-green background, resulting in very low contrast and making the offer almost illegible.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner background or change the headline and subtext to a dark green/black color that meets WCAG contrast requirements against the mint background, keeping the 'Order now' button style as-is.
